Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; continued rises will be a headwind. Also, monitor AI sentiment for any further cracks.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers aggressively and stay disciplined with stops, especially with market headwinds.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL stops. Both are leveraged and deeply in the red; consider trimming to manage risk given their breached default stops.
